jobs.description:
We’re looking for a data platform lead with a commercial mindset, ready to help our clients find out where AI fits and to play a central role in growing their business around it.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you’ll advise clients on their data platform and AI choices, design the architectures, build them yourself, and lead the teams that deliver them. It’s a role that’s equal parts business-facing and technical: you’ll design and build on Snowflake, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric, and be just as at home in the client meeting.

Beyond the client work, you’ll team up with colleagues across The Tech Collective and Implement to spot opportunities, shape scopes, and help win the work. Having built these platforms makes you credible when you sell them, and selling them keeps you building what clients need. As the team grows, you’ll also help shape the offering itself: reference architectures, propositions, and people.

What You’ll Bring

You’re a builder at heart. You have experience designing and delivering data platforms in at least one of Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and you can weigh them against each other. To be a great fit, it helps if you have:

• A commercial mindset – you spot opportunities, shape scopes, contribute to proposals, and are comfortable in a room with senior business stakeholders

• Fluency in AI and how it depends on the data platform – from data foundations and governance to taking AI use cases into production

• Experience leading projects or engineering teams (e.g., as an engineering manager or tech lead) while staying close to the code

• Clear communication with both engineers and executives, and the ability to turn platform choices into business decisions

• A collaborative style – you develop the people around you and enjoy building something together with others

What We Offer

At The Tech Collective, you’ll be part of a team that blends nerdiness, energy, and a sincere interest in people. You’ll have influence over how we grow, close sparring with experienced peers, and the chance to shape the offering as it develops.

Our culture is built on high autonomy with responsibility, co-creation, and active knowledge-sharing. You’ll work on projects across industries and disciplines – from strategy rooms to solution pilots with leading technologies. And to support your growth, we also provide internal training, keynotes, and hands-on learning across AI, data, cyber, and digital strategy.

How To Apply

• We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application ASAP

• Please apply with your CV, cover letter, and university transcripts

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI, and analytics, ensuring that they are ready for what comes next.

Ready to shape the digital future with us?

jobs.occupation: Production Optimization Specialist, Packaging & Digital Development - Krusaa
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of our packaging operation through new packaging solutions, data analytics, digital tools and AI-based solutions that optimize production? If you bring a structured approach, technical understanding and enjoy collaborating across functions, you could be our new Production Optimization Specialist for Packaging and Digital Development for Kruså Dairy.

Kruså Dairy produces around 30,000 tons of white cheese each year for markets across the world. We are on an exciting development journey where digitalization, automation and sustainable packaging solutions are playing an increasingly important role in our daily operations.

How you will make an impact

In this role, you will be a key contributor to the development of our packaging operation. You will have a broad network across the site and work closely with our Packaging Engineer as well as colleagues in Production, Quality, Maintenance and IT. Your focus will be to turn tests, production data and new technology into practical improvements.

• 
Plan, coordinate and follow up on tests of packaging, labels, printers and labelling solutions, ensuring that results, deviations, decisions and follow-up actions are documented.

• 
Analyze production data to identify losses, bottlenecks, causes of stops and improvement opportunities related to change over time, uptime, waste, quality and traceability.

• 
Identify and test relevant digital and automated solutions, including AI-based tools, where they can create measurable value for the operation.

• 
Support SAP processes and continuously build your capabilities towards becoming a SAP Super User for the packaging area.

• 
Contribute to the correct use and quality assurance of relevant master data and production data.

What will make you successful

You are motivated by development, technology and collaboration. Your educational background is less important than the competencies, experience and proven results you bring. You may have a relevant degree or have developed your qualifications through practical experience.

Collaboration will be essential to your success. You enjoy coordinating activities across several functions and stakeholders, build strong working relationships and contribute actively to shared solutions. You communicate clearly and professionally in both Danish and English, and you have a genuine interest in technology, process improvement and development.

What do we offer?

At Arla in Kruså, you will step into a new role with significant opportunity to influence how our packaging operation develops. You will work closely with packaging and production specialists and have the opportunity to apply AI and digital technologies in a practical production environment. The role also offers development towards becoming a SAP Super User.

You will join a strong professional environment focused on learning and development, with career opportunities both at the dairy and across Arla. Locally, we also offer excellent canteen facilities, an active staff association and a strong social community.

Would you like to join us?

We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you better. Please apply as soon as possible, as we will review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and close the recruitment once the right candidate has been found.

For additional information about the position, please contact Operations Manager Mick Bonde Christensen on +45 2285 3452.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

The Impact You'll Make

Do you enjoy solving quality challenges, working closely with production teams, and turning data into meaningful improvements?

As a Quality Engineer at Danfoss in Silkeborg, you'll help ensure that quality is built into every stage of our manufacturing processes. Working closely with colleagues across production echnology, RD&E and production, you'll drive improvements that strengthen process capability, reduce defects, and enhance customer satisfaction.

Through your expertise in quality methods and continuous improvement, you'll play an important role in maintaining the high-quality behind our radiator thermostats and valves while supporting a culture where quality is everyone's responsibility.

What You’ll Be Doing

What you will be doing:

• Support production teams with daily quality challenges and lead investigations of quality deviations and customer complaints using structured problem-solving methods

• Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure quality requirements are embedded in new product introductions, process changes, and industrialization activities

• Use data analysis to identify trends, uncover root causes, and drive improvements that enhance product quality, process capability, and operational performance

• Promote a Quality-at-Source culture through coaching, training, and collaboration, helping employees build quality into everyday processes

• Strengthen and maintain the Quality Management System by supporting audits, ensuring compliance with internal and external requirements, and driving corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives

What We're Looking For

Essential Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field

• Experience working with quality assurance, quality control, or quality systems in a manufacturing environment

• Hands-on experience with quality tools such as 8D, FMEA, SPC, and MSA

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with knowledge of ISO 9001 and IATF 16949

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in both Danish and English

Preferred Qualifications

Experience as a certified internal or lead auditor would be an advantage.

Experience supporting new product introductions, industrialization projects, or automated manufacturing environments is also beneficial.

What You'll Get from Us

You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

#LI-GV2 #LI-Onsite

Our Commitment to Transparency

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our FAQ Page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Brand

Danfoss engineers solutions that increase machine productivity, reduce emissions, lower energy consumption, and enable electrification.

Our solutions are used in areas such as refrigeration, air conditioning, heating, power conversion, motor control, industrial machinery, marine, and on- and off-highway equipment. We also provide solutions for data centers, renewable energy, energy storage, heat recovery, as well as contribute to district energy solutions for cities.

Our innovative engineering dates back to 1933. Danfoss is family-owned and employs over 39,000 people. We create long-term value for our customers in more than 100 countries with a global footprint of around 100 factories.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Welder / Tack Welder for Weekend Day Shift
jobs.description:
Do you have solid experience in welding and tack welding, and do you thrive in a structured environment with clear expectations and a strong focus on quality and precision? At Give Steel A/S, you will become an important part of our weekend day shift production team, where your contribution helps ensure strong, documented steel structures.

Why Choose Us?

You will become part of a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company with a strong focus on quality, safety, and responsible production. We are committed to employee development and offer a workplace with freedom under responsibility, well-organised working conditions, and opportunities for professional growth.

You will be employed under the Danish Collective Agreement for the Industry Sector (Industriens Overenskomst). In addition, we offer private health insurance and the option to join our canteen scheme.

What Will Your Workday Look Like?

You will join a team manufacturing load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. The work is carried out on the weekend day shift, where you will follow established work procedures and contribute to ensuring tasks are completed safely, efficiently, and to a high standard of quality.

Your working hours will be from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Tack welding and welding steel structures based on technical drawings and work instructions

• Preparing components and checking measurements, fit, and quality

• Carrying out tasks with a systematic and thorough approach

• Contributing to strong teamwork with colleagues in production

• Complying with all applicable safety, quality, and documentation requirements

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced and reliable employee who works in a structured and detail-oriented manner. You thrive in a well-defined environment, can maintain an overview in a busy production setting, and take pride in delivering lasting, high-quality results.

We expect that you:

• Have solid experience as a welder and/or tack welder

• Work thoroughly, responsibly, and with a strong focus on quality

• Can read and understand technical drawings

• Are reliable and a team player

• Contribute positively to a professional and safe working environment

• Speak Danish and/or English

• Live in Denmark within a reasonable commuting distance of Brande

We can provide certification in various welding methods, so it is not important whether you already hold welding certificates.

Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, please contact our Head of Production, Tomas Slepavicius, at tsl@givesteel.com.

We would like to receive your CV, clearly outlining your relevant experience. We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, and we will remove the job advertisement once the position has been filled.

About Give Steel A/S

Give Steel A/S is a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company that develops, designs, manufactures, and erects load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. Quality, safety, and documentation are an integral part of our daily operations, while we also maintain a strong focus on CO₂ reduction and responsible production.

You will become part of an international company with strong technical expertise and opportunities for professional development. Collaboration, responsibility, and integrity are key values in our daily work.

PROJEKTLEDER – FACTSPILOT.COM

Internationalt medieprojekt · AI · Faktatjek · EU-finansiering

Vil du stå i spidsen for udviklingen af en international medieplatform med ambitioner om at arbejde på tværs af Europas lande og sprog?

MinBy™ søger en ambitiøs, selvstændig og resultatorienteret projektleder til Factspilot.com – et internationalt medie- og teknologiprojekt med fokus på journalistik, faktatjek, AI, oversættelse og distribution af nyheder.

Vi søger en person, der kan omsætte en ambitiøs idé til et konkret, finansieret og operationelt projekt.

En central indledende opgave bliver at undersøge, udvikle og koordinere en ansøgning til EU-programmet Creative Europe – Journalism Partnerships, herunder etablering af relevante europæiske samarbejdspartnere.

Det er en stilling for dig, der kan kombinere strategisk forståelse, international projektledelse, finansiering og praktisk gennemførelse.

OM MINBY™ OG FACTSPILOT.COM

MinBy™ udvikler et omfattende digitalt medienetværk med 1.522 ultralokale medier fordelt på Danmarks 98 kommuner samt 30 passions- og situationsbaserede magasinkoncepter.

Factspilot.com er et internationalt dimension med ambitionen om at udvikle en teknologisk platform, der kan understøtte:

• 
Indsamling og bearbejdning af journalistisk indhold fra flere lande.

• 
Faktatjek, kildekontrol og dokumentation.

• 
AI-understøttet oversættelse og flersproget publicering.

• 
Distribution af journalistisk indhold på tværs af lande og medier.

• 
Samarbejde mellem journalister, redaktioner og medieorganisationer.

• 
Nye modeller for international journalistisk produktion.

Målet er at skabe en skalerbar europæisk medieinfrastruktur, hvor teknologi, journalistisk kvalitet og internationale partnerskaber arbejder sammen.

DIN FØRSTE STORE OPGAVE – EU-PROJEKTET

Vi arbejder med muligheden for at søge støtte gennem Creative Europe – Journalism Partnerships.

Projektets foreløbige finansieringsramme tager udgangspunkt i muligheden for EU-støtte på op til 2 mio. euro, afhængigt af den konkrete ansøgningskategori og gældende betingelser.

Din opgave bliver at undersøge og udvikle grundlaget for en kvalificeret ansøgning.

Det omfatter blandt andet:

1. Projektudvikling

• 
Omsætte Factspilots vision til en konkret projektbeskrivelse.

• 
Definere mål, aktiviteter, leverancer og succeskriterier.

• 
Udarbejde projektplan, milepæle og tidsplan.

2. Internationalt partnerskab

• 
Identificere relevante medievirksomheder, organisationer og teknologipartnere i Europa.

• 
Etablere dialog og udvikle samarbejdsaftaler.

• 
Koordinere ansvarsfordeling og bidrag fra projektets partnere.

3. Finansiering og EU-ansøgning

• 
Analysere støtteprogrammets krav og muligheder.

• 
Udarbejde budget, finansieringsmodel og ansøgningsmateriale.

• 
Dokumentere projektets europæiske merværdi, gennemførlighed og forventede resultater.

• 
Koordinere ansøgningsprocessen frem til indsendelse.

4. Teknologi og redaktionel udvikling

• 
Samarbejde med tekniske og redaktionelle ressourcer.

• 
Beskrive platformens funktioner, udviklingsbehov og anvendelse af AI.

• 
Sikre sammenhæng mellem teknologisk udvikling og journalistiske behov.

5. Projektledelse og gennemførelse

• 
Opbygge en operationel projektorganisation.

• 
Koordinere økonomi, ressourcer, leverancer og rapportering.

• 
Forberede projektets implementering, hvis finansieringen opnås.

HVEM ER DU?

Du har erfaring med projektledelse, forretningsudvikling, internationale samarbejder eller finansierede udviklingsprojekter.

Erfaring med EU-programmer, fondsansøgninger eller medieprojekter er en betydelig fordel.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

• 
Kan drive et projekt selvstændigt fra idé til konkret resultat.

• 
Har stærke analytiske, organisatoriske og kommunikative evner.

• 
Kan udvikle projektbeskrivelser, budgetter og finansieringsplaner.

• 
Er god til at skabe relationer og opbygge internationale samarbejder.

• 
Behersker engelsk på et højt professionelt niveau.

• 
Har forståelse for teknologi, AI og digitale forretningsmodeller.

• 
Kan arbejde struktureret med komplekse krav og deadlines.

• 
Har gennemslagskraft, initiativ og et højt ambitionsniveau.

Du behøver ikke være journalist eller programmør. Det afgørende er, at du kan forstå projektets forskellige fagområder og få specialister til at arbejde sammen mod fælles mål.

HVAD TILBYDER VI?

Du får mulighed for at få en central rolle i udviklingen af et internationalt medieprojekt fra en tidlig fase.

Vi tilbyder:

• 
Betydelig indflydelse på projektets strategi og udvikling.

• 
Mulighed for at opbygge et internationalt samarbejdsnetværk.

• 
Arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem journalistik, teknologi, AI og europæisk finansiering.

• 
Direkte samarbejde med MinBy™s strategiske og tekniske ledelse.

• 
Mulighed for at udvikle rollen i takt med projektets finansiering og fremdrift.

Dette er ikke en traditionel administrativ projektlederstilling.

Vi søger en person, der selv kan identificere muligheder, træffe initiativer og skabe målbare resultater.

ANSÆTTELSE OG SAMARBEJDE

Vi er åbne over for forskellige samarbejdsformer afhængigt af kandidatens kompetencer og projektets udviklingsfase.

Arbejdsomfang, ansættelsesvilkår og aflønning aftales individuelt.

ANSØGNING OG UDVÆLGELSE

Vi vurderer kandidater på deres dokumenterede kompetencer, selvstændighed, erfaring og evne til at skabe resultater.

Relevante kandidater kan blive tilbudt en frivillig, praktisk testopgave med udgangspunkt i Factspilot og de konkrete muligheder for europæisk projektfinansiering.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du kan demonstrere, hvordan du vil gribe en kompleks opgave an – ikke blot beskrive dine tidligere erfaringer.

SØG STILLINGEN

Læs mere om MinBy™ på:

https://minbymedie.dk

Ansøgning sker via MinBy™s digitale rekrutteringssystem.

PROJECT MANAGER – FACTSPILOT.COM
International media project · AI · Fact-checking · EU funding

Do you want to head the development of an international media platform with ambitions to work across European countries and languages? MinBy™ is seeking an ambitious, independent, and results-oriented project manager for Factspilot.com – an international media and technology project focused on journalism, fact-checking, AI, translation, and news distribution.

We are looking for someone who can turn an ambitious idea into a concrete, funded, and operational project. A key initial task will be to research, develop, and coordinate an application for the EU program Creative Europe – Journalism Partnerships, including establishing relevant European partnerships.

This position is for you if you can combine strategic understanding, international project management, financing, and practical execution.

ABOUT MINBY™ AND FACTSPILOT.COM
MinBy™ develops an extensive digital media network featuring 1,522 ultra-local media outlets distributed across Denmark’s 98 municipalities, alongside 30 passion- and situation-based magazine concepts.

Factspilot.com is an international dimension with the ambition to develop a technological platform that can support:

• 
Gathering and processing journalistic content from multiple countries.

• 
Fact-checking, source verification, and documentation.

• 
AI-supported translation and multilingual publishing.

• 
Distribution of journalistic content across countries and media.

• 
Collaboration between journalists, newsrooms, and media organizations.

• 
New models for international journalistic production.

The goal is to create a scalable European media infrastructure where technology, journalistic quality, and international partnerships work together.

YOUR FIRST MAJOR TASK – THE EU PROJECT
We are working on the opportunity to apply for funding through Creative Europe – Journalism Partnerships. The project's preliminary financial framework is based on the possibility of EU support of up to EUR 2 million, depending on the specific application category and applicable conditions.

Your task will be to research and develop the foundation for a qualified application. This includes, among other things:

• 
Project Development

• 
Translating Factspilot’s vision into a concrete project description.

• 
Defining objectives, activities, deliverables, and success criteria.

• 
Preparing the project plan, milestones, and timeline.

• 
International Partnership

• 
Identifying relevant media companies, organizations, and technology partners in Europe.

• 
Establishing dialogue and developing partnership agreements.

• 
Coordinating the division of responsibilities and contributions from project partners.

• 
Financing and EU Application

• 
Analyzing the requirements and opportunities of the funding program.

• 
Preparing the budget, financing model, and application materials.

• 
Documenting the project’s European added value, feasibility, and expected results.

• 
Coordinating the application process up until submission.

• 
Technology and Editorial Development

• 
Collaborating with technical and editorial resources.

• 
Describing the platform’s features, development needs, and use of AI.

• 
Ensuring alignment between technological development and journalistic needs.

• 
Project Management and Implementation

• 
Building an operational project organization.

• 
Coordinating finances, resources, deliverables, and reporting.

• 
Preparing for the project’s implementation if funding is secured.

WHO ARE YOU?
You have experience in project management, business development, international collaborations, or funded development projects. Experience with EU programs, grant applications, or media projects is a significant advantage.

We place particular emphasis on you being able to:

• 
Drive a project independently from idea to concrete results.

• 
Possess strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

• 
Develop project descriptions, budgets, and financing plans.

• 
Excel at building relationships and establishing international partnerships.

• 
Master English at a high professional level.

• 
Understand technology, AI, and digital business models.

• 
Work structured with complex requirements and deadlines.

• 
Demonstrate impact, initiative, and a high level of ambition.

You do not need to be a journalist or a programmer. The crucial factor is that you can understand the project’s various professional fields and make specialists work together toward common goals.

WHAT WE OFFER
You will have the opportunity to take on a central role in the development of an international media project from an early stage. We offer:

• 
Significant influence on the project’s strategy and development.

• 
The opportunity to build an international network of collaborators.

• 
Work at the intersection of journalism, technology, AI, and European funding.

• 
Direct collaboration with MinBy™’s strategic and technical leadership.

• 
The opportunity to develop the role in tandem with the project’s funding and progress.

This is not a traditional administrative project management position. We are looking for an individual who can identify opportunities, take initiative, and create measurable results themselves.

EMPLOYMENT AND COLLABORATION
We are open to different forms of collaboration depending on the candidate’s competencies and the project's development phase. Workload, terms of employment, and remuneration will be negotiated individually.

APPLICATION AND SELECTION
We assess candidates based on their documented competencies, independence, experience, and ability to deliver results. Relevant candidates may be offered a voluntary, practical test assignment based on Factspilot and the specific opportunities for European project funding.

We emphasize that you can demonstrate how you would approach a complex task – not just describe your past experiences.

APPLY FOR THE POSITION
Read more about MinBy™ at: https://minbymedie.dk
Applications must be submitted via MinBy™’s digital recruitment system.

About Driversnote

Driversnote is a profitable, product-led SaaS company based in Copenhagen that helps over 4.5 million users simplify mileage tracking, with paying customers in 100+ countries. Our core product is a freemium mobile app, often paired with our iBeacon hardware for precise, automated mileage logging, and backed by a powerful web platform.

We’re a close-knit team of 50 working together across design, mobile and web development, marketing, support, sales and customer success. We’ve quadrupled our ARR in the last three years by staying focused on delivering real value to our users, and we’re now expanding from B2C into B2B, building advanced features for teams.

Our Customer Success and Support team is locally anchored in Denmark, Canada and Australia. Customers get help in their own time zone from people who know their market, its rules and how its businesses work.

The role

As Customer Success Manager for EMEA, you own a portfolio of our larger business customers and make sure they get real value from Driversnote, renew, and grow.

This is an outcome-led role, not a usage-monitoring one. Teams today can build their own tracking or buy a system that includes it, so we win by helping customers save money, stay compliant and run their mileage process with less effort. You’ll be the person who makes that happen for your accounts.

Success looks like this after your first year:

• 
Your accounts renew, and you know why the few that leave did

• 
New accounts are live and in use within weeks, not months

• 
Your accounts grow in licences and use more of what we offer

• 
Customers see you as a trusted adviser on mileage, reimbursement and compliance, and Driversnote is built into how they work, from their mileage policy to their payroll and AI tools

What you’ll do

• 
Own retention and renewals. Manage renewals for your accounts from start to finish, spot risk early and act on it.

• 
Get new accounts live. Run onboarding for new teams, with kickoffs for admins, managers and drivers, so the first year sets them up for success.

• 
Grow your accounts. Find expansion opportunities where it makes sense, help teams roll out to more drivers and pass qualified leads to Sales.

• 
Lead outcome-focused reviews. Run annual and quarterly business reviews built around what customers achieve, not just how much they use the app.

• 
Be the expert. Advise customers on mileage reimbursement policy, tax compliance and audit-readiness in your markets.

• 
Get Driversnote deeper into their processes. Help customers improve how they handle mileage end to end: shaping their mileage policy, connecting Driversnote to payroll, finance and AI tools, and removing manual steps, so we become part of how they work, not just an app they use.

• 
Help shape new services. Work with us as we build new offers, such as fleet mileage reports, CO2 reporting and compliance checks.

• 
Keep the data clean. Use HubSpot, health scores and AI tools to manage your portfolio, and log why customers leave so we can learn from it.

• 
Be the customer’s voice. Share what you hear with Product, Sales and Support to improve the product.

What we’re looking for

• 
A few years’ experience in customer success, account management or implementation, ideally in B2B SaaS

• 
Experience owning renewals or a revenue target, or helping customers get live with a new system

• 
Native or near-native English, written and spoken, since many of our customers are in the UK

• 
A commercial mindset: you can turn a customer’s goals into a reason to renew and grow

• 
Comfortable with data, CRM tools and AI; you use numbers to spot risk and show value

• 
A real interest in using AI to create more value, not just to work faster. We take AI seriously here, not as a buzzword: you’ll use and help shape the AI agents and workflows our team relies on every day

• 
Clear, warm communication with everyone from drivers to finance directors

• 
The role is based in our Copenhagen office, and you need a valid permit to work in Denmark

Nice to have

• 
Experience with expansion and upsell in existing accounts

• 
Additional languages are a plus

• 
Knowledge of mileage reimbursement, fleet management, payroll or tax compliance

• 
Experience with HubSpot

This role is probably not for you if…

• 
You want to stay at a strategic distance. This is a hands-on role: you’ll run onboardings, dig into data, fix problems and talk to drivers as well as finance directors.

• 
You only want large accounts. Your portfolio will be a mix of smaller teams and large accounts, and you need to enjoy both.

• 
You’re looking for enterprise sales. We don’t do long, complex corporate sales cycles. If large enterprise selling is what drives you, this isn’t the right fit.

What we offer

• 
Ownership from day one: a high-impact role where you own our B2B customers in the EMEA region.

• 
Shape how we do it: help build the B2B success motion for an established, profitable company.

• 
People to learn from: work with a team of highly experienced entrepreneurs and tech people, across Denmark, Canada and Australia.

• 
Growth: a clear career path in Customer Success, with specialisations as our services grow.

• 
Balance: a healthy work-life balance.

• 
Location and benefits: our Copenhagen office, pension and a learning budget.

We work in a relaxed environment in new offices near the Meatpacking District. Every day there’s a tasty, freshly cooked lunch (with a vegetarian option) and great coffee. We also have cosy Friday drinks and great events, from our running club and gaming nights to our epic Christmas and summer parties.

How to apply

Fill out an application here

We review applications and respond to candidates on an ongoing basis, so apply soon. We aim for a start date of 1 December or 1 January, depending on your availability, but finding the right fit matters more to us than a deadline. Expect a case during the interview process: it represents the kind of work you’ll do with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Senior Utility Engineer – Plant Engineering (Søborg)

****Keep life-changing therapies moving by keeping our utilities running.

**Location: _Søborg, Denmark. Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

_AGC Biologics is expanding its Utility team in Søborg and is looking for an experienced Senior Utility Engineer with strong expertise in GMP-regulated pharmaceutical water systems. You will play an important role in ensuring the safe, reliable and compliant operation of utility systems that support our 24/7 research, development and production activities.

**About The Department

**The Utility team is responsible for critical utility systems that support production and laboratory operations at our Søborg site. These include pharmaceutical water systems and other essential utilities. You will work closely with Production, QA, Validation, Maintenance and Project teams in a regulated environment where reliability, compliance and patient safety are key priorities.

**The role

**As Senior Utility Engineer, you will take technical ownership of GMP-critical water systems across the site. This is a hands-on, operational role focused on compliance, troubleshooting, risk reduction and continuous improvement. You will work alongside two skilled technicians who carry out scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, while you focus on system performance, technical oversight and long-term improvements.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Ensuring the stable, compliant and efficient operation of pharmaceutical water systems.

• Taking technical ownership of systems and driving improvements to reliability and performance.

• Maintaining technical documentation, including SOPs, P&IDs and maintenance plans, in line with GMP requirements.

• Leading troubleshooting, root cause analysis, risk assessments and CAPA activities.

• Supporting commissioning, qualification and handover of utility projects to Operations and Maintenance.

• Providing technical input to CAPEX and OPEX projects.

• Representing Utilities during audits and inspections.

• Acting as the senior technical contact for water systems and providing guidance to colleagues across the site.

Most work takes place during regular business hours, although occasional evening or weekend work may be required to support our 24/7 production environment.

Initially, your primary focus will be pharmaceutical water systems. Over time, your responsibilities may expand to include black and clean utilities, allowing you to contribute more broadly across the Utility team.

**Experience And Competences

**We are looking for an experienced Senior Utility Engineer with substantial experience working with pharmaceutical water systems in a GMP-regulated environment.

**To Succeed In The Role, You Have

**

• An engineering degree in mechanical, electrical or chemical engineering, or a similar field, or an equivalent technical background combined with relevant experience.

• Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical water systems and applicable GMP/GxP requirements.

• Experience with troubleshooting, maintenance and optimisation of technical systems.

• Experience with technical documentation, deviations, CAPAs, risk assessments and regulatory inspections.

• The ability to take technical ownership, solve complex problems and drive improvements independently.

• The ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and communicate technical information clearly.

Experience with GMP utilities, project handovers, black and clean utilities, regulatory audits and mentoring colleagues is an advantage.

**As a person, you are

**You are proactive, independent and comfortable taking ownership of your responsibilities. You are structured and solution-oriented, with a strong focus on quality and compliance. You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively across teams and enjoy sharing knowledge with colleagues. You are comfortable balancing operational priorities with technical documentation and continuous improvement.

**AGC offers

**At AGC Biologics, you will work with critical utility systems in a dynamic pharmaceutical production environment. You will join a collaborative team where knowledge sharing, ownership and practical problem-solving are valued. The role offers the opportunity to develop your technical expertise and contribute to the reliable operation of systems that support our production activities around the clock.

**How To Apply

**Please submit your application and CV through the AGC Biologics career site. We do not accept applications by email.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the deadline if a suitable candidate is found.

Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

We look forward to receiving your application!

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies.
